source: segmentation (internet footage, background replaced by pure white)
time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0

camera.status: no background visible (white), so camera motion cannot be measured; boat drifts steadily right in image coordinates and does not change size (length 230-237 px, no trend), consistent with a static or near-static side-on camera

objects.name: boat
objects.description: long wooden (orange-brown) canoe/dugout boat seen side-on, square stern at LEFT, pointed upturned bow at RIGHT, some dark cargo mid-deck
objects.reference_point: cx,cy = bbox centre of the whole foreground (boat+person); mask_cx/mask_cy = mask centroid; hull_x0 = stern end, hull_x1 = bow tip
objects.direction: to the right (+x), essentially horizontal; y drifts up ~3 px over clip

objects.name: person (boatman)
objects.description: single person in dark/blue clothing standing at the stern (left end) of the boat, handling a pole/paddle
objects.moves: rides with the boat; arm/paddle movements
objects.note: lower body hidden inside the boat (flag occluded=1); bbox width sometimes includes the paddle

events.event: boat moving right at start of clip (already in motion)
boat still moving right at end of clip, no stop
